confidentiality_term: The obligations in this Section continue for three (3) years after the date of each disclosure, except that obligations for trade secrets continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret under applicable law.
limitation_of_liability: Except for breach of confidentiality or a party's indemnity obligations, each party's total liability under this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twenty-four (24) months before the event giving rise to the claim.
indemnification: Each party will defend and indemnify the other against third-party claims arising from its infringement of intellectual property or its breach of confidentiality, subject to the limitation of liability in this Agreement.
governing_law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Delaware.
payment_terms: Customer will pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt. Late amounts accrue interest at 1% per month.
auto_renewal: This Agreement renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the current term.
non_solicitation: During the term and for twelve (12) months after, neither party will solicit the other's employees for employment, except through general advertisements not targeted at the other party's staff.
assignment: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld, except that either party may assign it to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all of its business.
